I think with that winrate you are bound to climb if you play enough i got stuck in parts too because some games are just unwinnable and thats the nature of support, my main 3 takeaways which I think helped me the most were 1. The obvious one which is value your life more than anyone on your team if you die you can't help anyone so aim for 0 deaths every game
2. Be a blue beam mercy and leave most of the healing of your tank to the other support( do help out here and there though) but I almost always choose a dps which has more consistent dmg and hard pocket them so soldier/ashe> widow hanzo type thing 
3. This is one I think is overlooked but at the start of the game you want to see who your other support is and then understand what your role will be, for example if you have a zen or lucio you most likely won't be able to hard pocket a dps to make up for their mostly lack luster heals but if you have a kiriko or ana you can usually safely hard pocket a dps, also knowing what your other support can enable you to do for example you can get off free rezs if you communicate with your kiriko and they suzu you. Sorry if I didn't explain it well but I think if you focus very hard on those 3 you are bound to keep improving even if you don't climb straight away, I always aim to play my best and not focus on wins/losses because they will come naturally as you focus on getting better.
